warm_up:
Activation & Mobilisation Drills:
1 round
Warm Up
10 Scap Push Ups
10 scap Pull ups
10 x Inch Worms
10 I-Y-T-W
10 Leg Raise holding rig
Wrist Mobilisation
Banded Pull Aparts x 10
5 x PVC Pipe Around the world
gymnastics:
Tabata 20 seconds on - 10 seconds off x 5 mins (00:00)
Hollow & Arch Hold
T2B Bar Progression
1-2 mins False Grip on bar - focus on Knuckles Up (6:00)
EMOM x 3 (8:00)
10 x Beat Swing
EMOM x 3 (11:00)
Bigger Beat Swing - Push Down on Bar
- Put Ball between feet - Reach Long in the Arch - Dont bend the knees
EMOM x 3 (15:00)
Knees to Chest - Aggressive & Pop - pause at the top
EMOM x 3 (18:00)
Beat Swing with Straight legs - to target
Aim for height without losing tension.
the goal is to chain them together
EMOM x 3 (21:00)
Aggressive Knees to chest - with toe flick
EMOM x 5 (T2B Attempt) (24:00-29:00)
HSW Progression
5 mins - Handstand Kick Up 10 Reps (33:00)
Beginners - Start from a Pike - Pop up with 1 foot only
Aim for soft feet onto wall
5 mins - Nose & toes to wall - Keep in a hollow (38:00)
Accumulate 2 mins total
5 mins - Nose & toes Shoulder taps - (40:00)
Shift Weight between hands
5 mins - HSW Attempts or stay with a prior progression (45:00-50:00)

hypertrophy.reasoning: Core, shoulders, and triceps are heavily fatigued by T2B, HSW, and handstand work today.
